title: Mobile 🐕 Dog Grooming in  Anaheim, CA - Groombuggy

facts.fact: Groombuggy's booking flow states that no credit card is required.
Groombuggy states that its groomer takes only 10 minutes of the customer's time during a visit.
facts.quote: We take only 10 minutes of your time and you can relax at home while we groom your dog.

facts.fact: Groombuggy claims that in-shop grooming often takes over 3 hours of a customer's day due to travel, drop-off, and waiting.
facts.quote: Often takes over 3 hours of your day due to travel, drop-off, and waiting.

facts.fact: Groombuggy's marketing copy refers to 'the 4-hour trips to the groomer' that its mobile service avoids.
facts.quote: Forget the 4-hour trips to the groomer.

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that its team is available 24/7 to schedule, answer questions, and address concerns.
facts.unit: hours per day, days per week
facts.quote: Our team is available 24/7 to schedule, answer questions, and address any concerns.

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that anal gland expression is provided at no extra charge upon request.
facts.quote: Upon request, we'll provide this service at no extra charge.

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that a small additional fee applies if a customer requests use of a prescribed medicated shampoo during a bath.
Groombuggy states that ear plucking is performed upon request and an additional fee applies.
facts.quote: We’ll pluck those floppy (or pointy) ears upon request (additional fee applies)

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that nail dremeling (filing) is included in its service, with clipping used if the dog does not tolerate it.
facts.quote: We include nail dremeling (filing) in our service, but if your dog isn't a fan, we'll switch to clipping.

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that its vans are cleaned and sanitized after each session.
facts.quote: Groombuggy vans are cleaned and sanitized after each session ensuring no exposure to other dogs' illnesses.

facts.fact: Groombuggy states that there are no cages onboard its vans.
facts.quote: There are no cages onboard our vans.

facts.fact: Groombuggy's page states that it does not yet cover every area and offers a waitlist for customers in areas it has not launched.
facts.quote: Unfortunately we don't cover your area yet.

facts.fact: Groombuggy's page states that the brand is now called Barkbus and links to Barkbus.com.
